Hodges (1998, JRSS-B) hierarchical-model example: 341 federal-employee health-insurance plans within 45 states. Smoking-cessation meta-analysis (Silagy et al. 2003); random-effects logistic meta-analysis in Aitkin (1999) and Skrondal & Rabe-Hesketh (2004, GLLAMM). 27 studies (study = studyname x year), control/treatment (fac) fixed, quitters d out of n participants binomial. studyname and year are the components of the study id.

Speed-of-light measurements, five experiments (Expt) of 20 consecutive runs each; V&R MASS examine between-experiment variation of Speed by experiment, the help page states no model. Run is the within-experiment run index (ignore).

Repeated measurements of log-size on 79 Sitka spruce trees (54 ozone-chamber, 25 control), measured five times in 1988 (Diggle, Liang & Zeger, Analysis of Longitudinal Data; VR MASS 4th ed). Nested sampling design stated on the help page (Lentner & Bishop 1986): 3 growers selected at random, 4 boxes at random per grower, 3 clusters per box. Variance-components model with grower and box-within-grower (box 1-4 nested in grower, so the composite grower:box). cluster (1-3) is the within-box observation id, ignored.

formula: I(CTSIB == 1) ~ Sex + Age + Height + Weight + Surface + Vision + (1 | Subject)

Fully nested measurement-consistency design stated on the help page (Bliss 1967): 6 labs, 2 technicians per lab, 2 samples per technician (G/H, in fact identical), 2 replicate fat measurements each. formula: seizures ~ treat + expind + treat:expind + offset(log(timeadj)) + (1 | id)
notes: Longitudinal seizure-count clinical trial (Thall & Vail 1990): 59 patients, a baseline period and four treatment periods per patient (id the grouping). Chatfield, Problem Solving: A Statistician's Guide. 39 ankylosing-spondylitis patients, two sides (left/right) measured per person (78 rows).
